topPRs.title: sep/112-113: OP Sepolia OPE batcher and proposer rotation
topPRs.author: donoso-eth
topPRs.body:
Adds `src/tasks/sep/112-op-sepolia-set-batcher` and `src/tasks/sep/113-op-sepolia-proposer-rotation`, the OP Sepolia OP Enterprise key rotation for the Oct 15 ceremony ([solutions#1546](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/solutions/issues/1546)):

- **sep/112** sets the batcher `0x64EDa4F93314ECd619bd4f79D8d1F8112A4E6e16` on the `SystemConfigProxy` `0x034edD2A225f7f429A63E0f1D2084B9E0A93b538` with `setBatcherHash`, executed by the FoundationUpgradeSafe. The unsafe block signer is pinned to its current value, so only `setBatcherHash` is emitted — one call, not two.
- **sep/113** rotates the `SUPER_PERMISSIONED` (5) proposer to `0x9884C33C65111DA7Bbed0e63cD2392F503b135F5` with `SetDisputeGameArgs`, signed by the L1PAO. Impl, anchorStateRegistry and the zero bond are read live and kept.



**Pending:** `SystemConfig.owner()` is still the EOA `0xfd1D2e72…` and must `transferOwnership` to the FoundationUpgradeSafe before sep/112 executes; config.toml overrides slot `0x33` until then.

Tasks carried over from #1568, which keeps sep/114 (unsafe signer, Oct 30). Nonce pins follow sep/110-111: sep/112 FUS 79, sep/113 L1PAO 58 / FUS 80 / SC 72.

topPRs.title: sep/115: OP Sepolia OPE batcher rollback (contingency for sep/112)
topPRs.author: jelias2
topPRs.body:
Adds `src/tasks/sep/115-op-sepolia-set-batcher-rollback`, the rollback for the OP Sepolia batcher rotation in the OPM → OPE cutover.

Runbook: https://app.notion.com/p/3f4f153ee162801e89bec6a2ab677a4a

**Execute only during the cutover window: the forward task at step C10, this task (sep/115) only for rollback RB3.**

- **Forward task (A)**: sep/112 in #1571 (`setBatcherHash` → OPE batcher `0x64EDa4F93314ECd619bd4f79D8d1F8112A4E6e16`, OPE KMS key, keyring `op-sepolia-0`). It is not duplicated here.
- **Rollback task (B), this PR**: sep/115 `setBatcherHash` → legacy batcher `0x8F23BB38F531600e5d8FDDaAEC41F13FaB46E98c` on `SystemConfigProxy` `0x034edD2A225f7f429A63E0f1D2084B9E0A93b538`. The unsafe block signer is pinned to its current value, so only `setBatcherHash` is emitted.

### Owner safe

`SystemConfig.owner()` = FoundationUpgradeSafe `0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B`. It is a single-level 2-of-13 Safe whose 13 owners are all EOAs. Live nonce is 77.

### Nonce

sep/115 is pinned to FoundationUpgradeSafe nonce **80** (sep/112 = 79, + 1), and simulates against `batcherHash` overridden to the OPE batcher (the state after sep/112). Nonce 80 is also pinned by sep/113 (proposer rotation, #1571), so the two compete:
- If no rollback is needed, executing sep/113 at nonce 80 invalidates the sep/115 signatures. Hold sep/113 until the RB3 window closes.
- If RB3 happens, sep/115 takes nonce 80, and sep/113, sep/114 and sep/116-118 must be re-signed at +1.

The task README has the details.

### Simulation

`SIMULATE_WITHOUT_LEDGER=1 just --dotenv-path $(pwd)/.env simulate` with forge 1.1.0 (mise pin) passes. State diff:
- SystemConfigProxy slot `0x67` (`batcherHash`): `0x…64eda4f9…6e16` → `0x…8f23bb38…e98c`
- FoundationUpgradeSafe nonce: 80 → 81

Domain `0x37e1f5dd3b92a004a23589b741196c8a214629d4ea3a690ec8e41ae45c689cbb`, message `0x358b1a6fcc038a406955a8b5b16a533c0e3fe595c6c260dbe405509743403ed7`.

Draft. Do not sign until the runbook and nonce plan are confirmed.

topPRs.title: [DO NOT MERGE] reference: OP Sepolia SystemConfig owner EOA → FoundationUpgradeSafe
topPRs.author: Wazabie
topPRs.body:
**Do not merge** 

Reference only: 

- The OP Sepolia `SystemConfigProxy` owner is the EOA `0xfd1D2e729aE8eEe2E146c033bf4400fE75284301`. Moving it to the Sepolia FoundationUpgradeSafe (`0xDEe57160aAfCF04c34C887B5962D0a69676d3C8B`) is a single `transferOwnership(address)` `cast` transaction by the key holder, not a Safe task. 

- This folder documents it in README/VALIDATION (calldata breakdown, signing-address check, pre-execution, expected slot `0x33` change and `OwnershipTransferred` event, post-execution checks).

- Prerequisite for sep/112 and sep/114 in #1568, which currently simulate with a `SystemConfig.owner()` override

topPRs.title: chore: retire the Unichain mainnet ChainGovernorSafe
topPRs.author: OptimismBot
topPRs.body:
## Summary

Retires the Unichain mainnet Chain Governor Safe (`0xb0c4C487C5cf6d67807Bc2008c66fa7e2cE744EC`) now that Unichain uses the standard OP-governed L1PAO.

- [eth/069](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/blob/main/src/tasks/eth/069-unichain-l1-ownership-transfers/README.md) and [eth/070](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/blob/main/src/tasks/eth/070-unichain-l2pao-transfer/README.md) are executed. The Unichain 3-of-3 (`0x6d5B183F538ABB8572F5cD17109c617b994D5833`) no longer owns any Unichain contract. Verified on-chain on 2026-10-09: `owner()` returns `0x5a0Aae59D09fccBdDb6C6CcEB07B7279367C3d2A` for `ProxyAdmin` `0x3B73…f2A4` and `DisputeGameFactoryProxy` `0x2F12…dFe4`.
- U20 ([eth/071](https://github.com/ethereum-optimism/superchain-ops/blob/main/src/tasks/eth/071-U20-op-ink-soneium-uni/README.md)) has since upgraded Unichain from the standard L1PAO.
- No eth task that is still open (not `EXECUTED`, `CANCELLED` or `APPROVED`) references `chain-governor` or `ChainGovernorSafe`.

## Changes

- `src/addresses.toml`: drop the `[eth]` `ChainGovernorSafe` entry.
- `src/script/get-safe.sh`: drop the `chain-governor` alias and the now-unreachable Sepolia guard for it.
- `test/registry/SimpleAddressRegistry.t.sol`: drop the mainnet `ChainGovernorSafe` assertion.
- `docs/NESTED.md`, `docs/NEW_TEMPLATE_GUIDE.md`, `src/script/simulate-task.sh`, `src/template/boilerplate/README.template.md`: stop listing `chain-governor` as a safe option.

## Not changed

- The `[sep]` `ChainGovernorSafe` entry stays. It's only referenced by the cancelled `sep/071-chain-governor-rotation` via `safeAddressString`, and I haven't verified the Sepolia Unichain ownership status.
- Executed tasks and their `VALIDATION.md` files are left as historical records. Re-simulating 069/070 with `chain-governor` will no longer resolve the safe name.
- Regression tests that hardcode `0x6d5B…5833` / `0xb0c4…44EC` at pinned blocks are untouched.

## Testing

- `bash -n src/script/get-safe.sh` passes.
- `forge test` was not run locally (submodule build too heavy for the sandbox); relying on CI.

Prompted by: @mds1
